'''2003 Mystic Visions''' was a Star Wars CCG tournament in Columbia, Pennsylvania (3 May 2003). It was the Mystic Visions Open, a Players Committee Open Qualifier directed by [[Michael Carr|Mike Carr]]; [[Jon Westergard]] and [[Brandon Pahl]] qualified for Day 2 of the [[2003 World Championship]].<ref name="pc-events03">[https://web.archive.org/web/20031209110207/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/events.htm 2003 Events], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 9 December 2003.</ref>

Mystic Visions 2003 (Mystic Visions III) was a small charity convention for the Vigilant Fire Company of Columbia, held 2–4 May 2003 at Vigilant Fire Company #2, 10th & Mifflin Streets. All money from entry fees and food purchases went to the fire company.<ref name="pc-mv03">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/Events/2003/mysticvisions05012003.htm Mystic Visions 2003 Weekend is HERE!], swccgpc.com (1 May 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040622063805/http://www.swccgpc.com/News/Events/2003/mysticvisions05012003.htm Internet Archive]</ref> Mike Carr, described by the Players Committee as one of its most dedicated volunteers, hosted it. Mystic Visions had hosted one of the Committee's Mini-Opens in 2002, and in 2003 it hosted a full Open for Star Wars CCG.<ref name="pc-may03">[http://www.swccgpc.com/Archives/may03archives.htm May Updates], swccgpc.com (1 May 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20031229115404/http://www.swccgpc.com/Archives/may03archives.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Columbia, Pennsylvania
* '''Dates:''' 3 May 2003<ref name="pc-events03" />
* '''Venue:''' Mystic Visions, Columbia<ref name="pc-events03" />
* '''Time:''' 1pm<ref name="pc-events03" />
* '''Fee:''' $5<ref name="pc-events03" />
* '''Rounds:''' 6, with a Final Confrontation; [[Open]] constructed format (not Classic or Episode I)<ref name="pc-mv03" />
* '''Prizes:''' prizes for all, including two complete sets of [[Reflections III]] premiums, one complete set of [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy|Reflections II]] premiums, rook containers and t-shirts; two byes into Day 2 of the [[2003 World Championship]]; uncut sheets mailed to the winner<ref name="pc-mv03" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Michael Carr|Mike Carr]]<ref name="pc-events03" />
* '''Day 2 qualifiers:''' [[Jon Westergard]], [[Brandon Pahl]]<ref name="pc-events03" />

== Other events ==

On Friday 2 May at 6:30 pm the convention held a four-round Star Wars CCG constructed tournament in Open format, with prizes for all.<ref name="pc-mv03" /> The convention also ran [[The Lord of the Rings Trading Card Game|Lord of the Rings TCG]], Raw Deal, HeroClix and MechWarrior events, role-playing games and a comic swap. Charity auctions of rares, foils, promos and premiums followed the last Lord of the Rings and Star Wars CCG games on Saturday. Entry to the convention was $5 for one day or $12 for all three days, and Palladium Books provided giveaways.<ref name="pc-mv03" />
